entries.source_text: I ask the questions, not you.  Now, tell me what you are doing here.

entries.text: 是我问你，轮不到你来问我。现在告诉我，你在这里做什么？
entries.source_text: 是我问你，轮不到你来问我。现在告诉我，你在这里做什么？

entries.text: I'm just lost.
entries.source_text: I'm just lost.

entries.text: 我不过是迷路了。
entries.source_text: 我不过是迷路了。

entries.text: I'm here to make you a deal.
entries.source_text: I'm here to make you a deal.

entries.text: 我到这里来跟你谈笔买卖。
entries.source_text: 我到这里来跟你谈笔买卖。

entries.text: Yes?
entries.source_text: Yes?

entries.text: 嗯？
entries.source_text: 嗯？

entries.text: Hi. I'm new to the Children and was wondering if I could ask you a few questions.
entries.source_text: Hi. I'm new to the Children and was wondering if I could ask you a few questions.

entries.text: 嗨。我是新加入大教堂的，想知道能否问你几个问题。
entries.source_text: 嗨。我是新加入大教堂的，想知道能否问你几个问题。

entries.text: Never mind.
entries.source_text: Never mind.

entries.text: 没关系。
entries.source_text: 没关系。

entries.text: Nuhhh?
entries.source_text: Nuhhh?

entries.text: 唔唔？
entries.source_text: 唔唔？

entries.text: Of course, my child.
entries.source_text: Of course, my child.

entries.text: 当然，我的孩子。
entries.source_text: 当然，我的孩子。

entries.text: Thanks . . .
entries.source_text: Thanks . . .

entries.text: 谢谢……
entries.source_text: 谢谢……

entries.text: Never mind.
entries.source_text: Never mind.

entries.text: 没关系。
entries.source_text: 没关系。

entries.text: What are the Children's plans?
entries.source_text: What are the Children's plans?

entries.text: 大教堂的计划是什么？
entries.source_text: 大教堂的计划是什么？

entries.text: Changed my mind. No more questions.
entries.source_text: Changed my mind. No more questions.

entries.text: 我改变主意了。没有什么问题了。
entries.source_text: 我改变主意了。没有什么问题了。

entries.text: What you say if I told you I'm from a Vault?
entries.source_text: What you say if I told you I'm from a Vault?

entries.text: 如果我告诉你，我从一个避难所来，你会说什么呢？
entries.source_text: 如果我告诉你，我从一个避难所来，你会说什么呢？

entries.text: Our plans?  We are the messengers of evolution, my child. We follow the Master in his endless quest to heal the land and the people.
entries.source_text: Our plans?  We are the messengers of evolution, my child. We follow the Master in his endless quest to heal the land and the people.

entries.text: 我们的计划？我们是进化的使者，我的孩子。我们追随主教的无尽的使命，恢复这片土地和人们。
entries.source_text: 我们的计划？我们是进化的使者，我的孩子。我们追随主教的无尽的使命，恢复这片土地和人们。

entries.text: Really? Just what kind of evolution are you teaching?
entries.source_text: Really? Just what kind of evolution are you teaching?

entries.text: 真的？那你宣讲的进化是怎么回事？
entries.source_text: 真的？那你宣讲的进化是怎么回事？

entries.text: What kind of healing?
entries.source_text: What kind of healing?

entries.text: 什么样的恢复？
entries.source_text: 什么样的恢复？

entries.text: We know there is a higher level, a glorious place humanity should strive to reach.  Ours is the goal to find the life better, more fulfilling, than the present one, marred by hardship and strife.
entries.source_text: We know there is a higher level, a glorious place humanity should strive to reach.  Ours is the goal to find the life better, more fulfilling, than the present one, marred by hardship and strife.

entries.text: 我知道人类应该努力发展到一个更高的境界和更荣耀的地位。我们的目标是寻求更好的生活，相比现在被苦难和冲突损害的生活更值得为之奋斗。
entries.source_text: 我知道人类应该努力发展到一个更高的境界和更荣耀的地位。我们的目标是寻求更好的生活，相比现在被苦难和冲突损害的生活更值得为之奋斗。

entries.text: You're kidding, right?
entries.source_text: You're kidding, right?

entries.text: 你在说笑，对吗？
entries.source_text: 你在说笑，对吗？

entries.text: And have you found this higher level ?
entries.source_text: And have you found this higher level ?

entries.text: 你找到了这个更高的境界吗？
entries.source_text: 你找到了这个更高的境界吗？

entries.text: 【Angry】Why you!...【Calmly】You are forgiven. Not everyone is capable of seeing the light. But, tell me my child, why did you join us?
entries.source_text: 【Angry】Why you!...【Calmly】You are forgiven. Not everyone is capable of seeing the light. But, tell me my child, why did you join us?

entries.text: 【生气】你竟然……！【冷静下来】我可以宽恕你，不是每个人都有能力见到光明。但是，我的孩子，你告诉我，你为什么加入我们？
entries.source_text: 【生气】你竟然……！【冷静下来】我可以宽恕你，不是每个人都有能力见到光明。但是，我的孩子，你告诉我，你为什么加入我们？

entries.text: I had to see if this was as much of a joke as I'd heard. Now I know.
entries.source_text: I had to see if this was as much of a joke as I'd heard. Now I know.

entries.text: 我要看这是否跟我听过的笑话差不多。现在我知道了。
entries.source_text: 我要看这是否跟我听过的笑话差不多。现在我知道了。

entries.text: Sorry. I guess I was out of line.
entries.source_text: Sorry. I guess I was out of line.

entries.text: 抱歉。我想是我的觉悟还不够。
entries.source_text: 抱歉。我想是我的觉悟还不够。

entries.text: You know nothing.
entries.source_text: You know nothing.

entries.text: 你完全不了解。
entries.source_text: 你完全不了解。

entries.text: Yes, you were, but you are forgiven.  Now, if there are no more questions, I have work to do.
entries.source_text: Yes, you were, but you are forgiven.  Now, if there are no more questions, I have work to do.

entries.text: 是的，你是的，但你被宽恕了。现在，如果没有别的问题，我有事要忙。
entries.source_text: 是的，你是的，但你被宽恕了。现在，如果没有别的问题，我有事要忙。

entries.text: Actually, there are some more.
entries.source_text: Actually, there are some more.

entries.text: 事实上，我还有些问题。
entries.source_text: 事实上，我还有些问题。

entries.text: Nope, thanks.
entries.source_text: Nope, thanks.

entries.text: 不，谢谢。
entries.source_text: 不，谢谢。

entries.text: Of course. Please.  Continue.
entries.source_text: Of course. Please.  Continue.

entries.text: 当然。请。继续吧。
entries.source_text: 当然。请。继续吧。

entries.text: Yes, but you are...forgiven.  Go in peace, my child.
entries.source_text: Yes, but you are...forgiven.  Go in peace, my child.

entries.text: 是的，不过你……已经被宽恕了。你安心去吧，我的孩子。
entries.source_text: 是的，不过你……已经被宽恕了。你安心去吧，我的孩子。

entries.text: No, but with faith and hope, we're certain to find it. But all this should be known to you, my child.
entries.source_text: No, but with faith and hope, we're certain to find it. But all this should be known to you, my child.

entries.text: 不，但是由于信仰和希望，我们必定会找到它。这一切你应该了解的，我的孩子。
entries.source_text: 不，但是由于信仰和希望，我们必定会找到它。这一切你应该了解的，我的孩子。

entries.text: I know, but just a few more questions, please.
entries.source_text: I know, but just a few more questions, please.

entries.text: 我了解，只不过还要请问几个问题。
entries.source_text: 我了解，只不过还要请问几个问题。

entries.text: I know. Goodbye.
entries.source_text: I know. Goodbye.

entries.text: 我了解。再见。
entries.source_text: 我了解。再见。

entries.text: We cure the physical body to start.  You've certainly seen our hospitals.  Then we offer hope and healing for the spirit.
entries.source_text: We cure the physical body to start.  You've certainly seen our hospitals.  Then we offer hope and healing for the spirit.

entries.text: 我们从医治人们物质上的身体开始。你当然见过我们的医院。然后，我们提供精神上的希望和医治。
entries.source_text: 我们从医治人们物质上的身体开始。你当然见过我们的医院。然后，我们提供精神上的希望和医治。

entries.text: Wow. I almost believed that. You're good!
entries.source_text: Wow. I almost believed that. You're good!

entries.text: 哇。我几乎相信那些了。你们是好心的！
entries.source_text: 哇。我几乎相信那些了。你们是好心的！

entries.text: Where are these hospitals?
entries.source_text: Where are these hospitals?

entries.text: 这些医院在哪里呢？
entries.source_text: 这些医院在哪里呢？

entries.text: Our glorious effort has just reached Adytum and, of course, the Hub shines with our efforts there.  But, I have a feeling there's more you wish to ask.
entries.source_text: Our glorious effort has just reached Adytum and, of course, the Hub shines with our efforts there.  But, I have a feeling there's more you wish to ask.

entries.text: 我们光荣的努力刚到达内城区，当然，哈勃城那里也因我们的努力生气勃勃。但是，我有种感觉，你有更多的事情想问。
entries.source_text: 我们光荣的努力刚到达内城区，当然，哈勃城那里也因我们的努力生气勃勃。但是，我有种感觉，你有更多的事情想问。

entries.text: These are wondrous days.  Junktown now joins in Adytum and the Hub in our quest to save body and soul.  Is there more you wish to know, my child?
entries.source_text: These are wondrous days.  Junktown now joins in Adytum and the Hub in our quest to save body and soul.  Is there more you wish to know, my child?

entries.text: 这些都是不平凡的日子。迦克镇现在加入内城区和哈勃城的行列，都在我们履行拯救肉体和灵魂的使命中，你还想知道更多吗，我的孩子？
entries.source_text: 这些都是不平凡的日子。迦克镇现在加入内城区和哈勃城的行列，都在我们履行拯救肉体和灵魂的使命中，你还想知道更多吗，我的孩子？

entries.text: As a matter of fact . . .
entries.source_text: As a matter of fact . . .

entries.text: 事实上……
entries.source_text: 事实上……

entries.text: Nothing. I gotta go.
entries.source_text: Nothing. I gotta go.

entries.text: 没什么。我要走了。
entries.source_text: 没什么。我要走了。

entries.text: The Children's vision now stretches from Adytum, to the Hub, Junktown, and now gently caresses Shady Sands.  Why do you ask?
entries.source_text: The Children's vision now stretches from Adytum, to the Hub, Junktown, and now gently caresses Shady Sands.  Why do you ask?

entries.text: 大教堂的目光现在从内城区延伸，投向哈勃城，迦克镇，现在正轻抚着沙荫镇。你为什么要问这个？
entries.source_text: 大教堂的目光现在从内城区延伸，投向哈勃城，迦克镇，现在正轻抚着沙荫镇。你为什么要问这个？

entries.text: Just wondering. Can I ask you a few more questions?
entries.source_text: Just wondering. Can I ask you a few more questions?

entries.text: 只是觉得奇怪。我能多问你几个问题吗？
entries.source_text: 只是觉得奇怪。我能多问你几个问题吗？

entries.text: Nothing. I gotta go.
entries.source_text: Nothing. I gotta go.

entries.text: 没什么。我要走了。
entries.source_text: 没什么。我要走了。

entries.text: You are what?
entries.source_text: You are what?

entries.text: 你怎么了？
entries.source_text: 你怎么了？

entries.text: You heard me. Take me to see the Master, now!
entries.source_text: You heard me. Take me to see the Master, now!

entries.text: 你听见我的话吗。带我去见主教，马上！
entries.source_text: 你听见我的话吗。带我去见主教，马上！

entries.text: Uh, yes. Well.  Please follow me.
entries.source_text: Uh, yes. Well.  Please follow me.

entries.text: 哦，好的。嗯。请跟我来。
entries.source_text: 哦，好的。嗯。请跟我来。

entries.text: Oh, my child, you make no sense whatsoever.  please, find one of our physicians and get help.
entries.source_text: Oh, my child, you make no sense whatsoever.  please, find one of our physicians and get help.

entries.text: 哦，我的孩子，你真是词不达意呢。去吧，找我们的治疗师寻求帮助。
entries.source_text: 哦，我的孩子，你真是词不达意呢。去吧，找我们的治疗师寻求帮助。

entries.text: My child, talk to Lasher.  He'll help you with that.
entries.source_text: My child, talk to Lasher.  He'll help you with that.

entries.text: 我的孩子，你去跟拉舍尔谈谈吧。他会帮助你。
entries.source_text: 我的孩子，你去跟拉舍尔谈谈吧。他会帮助你。

entries.text: I said...
entries.source_text: I said...

entries.text: 我说……
entries.source_text: 我说……

entries.text: Are you deaf?  I said...
entries.source_text: Are you deaf?  I said...

entries.text: 你聋了吗？我说……
entries.source_text: 你聋了吗？我说……

entries.text: I will not repeat myself again!
entries.source_text: I will not repeat myself again!

entries.text: 我不会再重复了！
entries.source_text: 我不会再重复了！

entries.text: I will not say it again!
entries.source_text: I will not say it again!

entries.text: 我不会再说一次！
entries.source_text: 我不会再说一次！

entries.text: The Nightkin came to us a while ago.  They might be hideous mutants but they are extremely loyal to the Children.  As we all are.
entries.source_text: The Nightkin came to us a while ago.  They might be hideous mutants but they are extremely loyal to the Children.  As we all are.

entries.text: 夜之团刚到我们这里来服役。他们或许是丑恶的变种人，但他们对大教堂是非常忠诚的。象我们大家一样。
entries.source_text: 夜之团刚到我们这里来服役。他们或许是丑恶的变种人，但他们对大教堂是非常忠诚的。象我们大家一样。

entries.text: It is he who brought me the vision of the Unity and it is he who will bring peace to this troubled land.
entries.source_text: It is he who brought me the vision of the Unity and it is he who will bring peace to this troubled land.

entries.text: 是他让我看到统一的前景，是他将把和平带给这片不平静的土地。
entries.source_text: 是他让我看到统一的前景，是他将把和平带给这片不平静的土地。

entries.text: My child, you should know the Auditorium.  I give my sermons there.
entries.source_text:
My child, you should know the Auditorium.  I give my sermons
 there.

entries.text: 我的孩子，你应该知道那个礼堂。我在那里宣讲教义。
entries.source_text: 我的孩子，你应该知道那个礼堂。我在那里宣讲教义。

entries.text: Don't concern yourself with that.  Only the High Priests may enter.
entries.source_text: Don't concern yourself with that.  Only the High Priests may enter.

entries.text: 这不关你的事。只有高级牧师可以进入。
entries.source_text: 这不关你的事。只有高级牧师可以进入。

entries.text: I am but a humble servant of the Unity.
entries.source_text: I am but a humble servant of the Unity.

entries.text: 我只是为“同一”服务的一个低下仆人。
entries.source_text: 我只是为“同一”服务的一个低下仆人。

entries.text: We are the high priests of the great Dark God. Thirteen of us are so blessed to pass his mighty words to the rest of the Children.
entries.source_text: We are the high priests of the great Dark God. Thirteen of us are so blessed to pass his mighty words to the rest of the Children.

entries.text: 我们是伟大黑暗之神的高级牧师。我们十三人受到这样的祝福，传达他的强大命令给大教堂的其他人。
entries.source_text: 我们是伟大黑暗之神的高级牧师。我们十三人受到这样的祝福，传达他的强大命令给大教堂的其他人。

entries.text: I've no idea what you're talking about.
entries.source_text: I've no idea what you're talking about.

entries.text: 我不懂你在说些什么。
entries.source_text: 我不懂你在说些什么。

entries.text: The Children of the Cathedral hospitals provide the best care in all of this blasted, torn land. This care is vital to the Unity.
entries.source_text: The Children of the Cathedral hospitals provide the best care in all of this blasted, torn land. This care is vital to the Unity.

entries.text: 大教堂的医院给所有这些被诅咒的、破碎的土地提供最好的照顾。这种照顾对于“同一”是至关重要的。
entries.source_text: 大教堂的医院给所有这些被诅咒的、破碎的土地提供最好的照顾。这种照顾对于“同一”是至关重要的。

entries.text: The Unity is our search for a higher level of life, and unity with our fellow man.
entries.source_text: The Unity is our search for a higher level of life, and unity with our fellow man.

entries.text: “同一”是我们寻求更高级别的生活，团结我们同道的人。
entries.source_text: “同一”是我们寻求更高级别的生活，团结我们同道的人。

entries.text: He is another High Priest.  He spends much of his time in the studies.
entries.source_text: He is another High Priest.  He spends much of his time in the studies.

entries.text: 他是另一个高级牧师。他在研究上花费大量的时间。
entries.source_text: 他是另一个高级牧师。他在研究上花费大量的时间。

entries.text: My heart bleeds for them.  Led down a false path.  They don't know their efforts will bring only pain and suffering to their fellow beings.
entries.source_text: My heart bleeds for them.  Led down a false path.  They don't know their efforts will bring only pain and suffering to their fellow beings.

entries.text: 我替他们感到痛心。他们走在一条错误的道路上，不知道自己的努力只会给人民带来痛苦和苦难。
entries.source_text: 我替他们感到痛心。他们走在一条错误的道路上，不知道自己的努力只会给人民带来痛苦和苦难。

entries.text: The Nightkin came to us a while ago.  They might be hideous mutants but they are extremely loyal to the Children.  As we all are.
entries.source_text: The Nightkin came to us a while ago.  They might be hideous mutants but they are extremely loyal to the Children.  As we all are.

entries.text: 夜之团刚到我们这里来服役。他们或许是丑恶的变种人，但他们对大教堂是非常忠诚的。象我们大家一样。
entries.source_text: 夜之团刚到我们这里来服役。他们或许是丑恶的变种人，但他们对大教堂是非常忠诚的。象我们大家一样。

entries.text: It is he who brought me the vision of the Unity and it is he who will bring peace to this troubled land.
entries.source_text: It is he who brought me the vision of the Unity and it is he who will bring peace to this troubled land.

entries.text: 是他让我看到统一的前景，是他将会把和平带给这片不平静的土地。
entries.source_text: 是他让我看到统一的前景，是他将会把和平带给这片不平静的土地。

entries.text: My child, you should know the Auditorium.  I give my sermons there.
entries.source_text:
My child, you should know the Auditorium.  I give my sermons
 there.

entries.text: 我的孩子，你应该知道那个礼堂。我在那里宣讲教义。
entries.source_text: 我的孩子，你应该知道那个礼堂。我在那里宣讲教义。

entries.text: Don't concern yourself with that.  Only the High Priests may enter.
entries.source_text: Don't concern yourself with that.  Only the High Priests may enter.

entries.text: 与你无关。只有高级牧师们能进去。
entries.source_text: 与你无关。只有高级牧师们能进去。

entries.text: I am but a humble servant of the Unity.
entries.source_text: I am but a humble servant of the Unity.

entries.text: 我只不过为“同一”服务的一个低下仆人。
entries.source_text: 我只不过为“同一”服务的一个低下仆人。

entries.text: We are the high priests of the great Dark God. Thirteen of us are so blessed to pass his mighty words to the rest of the Children.
entries.source_text: We are the high priests of the great Dark God. Thirteen of us are so blessed to pass his mighty words to the rest of the Children.

entries.text: 我们是伟大黑暗之神的高级牧师。我们十三人受到这样的祝福，将他的强大命令传达给大教堂的其他人。
entries.source_text: 我们是伟大黑暗之神的高级牧师。我们十三人受到这样的祝福，将他的强大命令传达给大教堂的其他人。

entries.text: I've no idea what you're talking about.
entries.source_text: I've no idea what you're talking about.

entries.text: 我不懂你在说些什么。
entries.source_text: 我不懂你在说些什么。

entries.text: The Children of the Cathedral hospitals provide the best care in all of this blasted, torn land. This care is vital to the Unity.
entries.source_text: The Children of the Cathedral hospitals provide the best care in all of this blasted, torn land. This care is vital to the Unity.

entries.text: 大教堂的医院给所有这些被诅咒的、破碎的土地提供最好的照顾。这种照顾对于“同一”是至关重要的。
entries.source_text: 大教堂的医院给所有这些被诅咒的、破碎的土地提供最好的照顾。这种照顾对于“同一”是至关重要的。

entries.text: The Unity is our search for a higher level of life, and unity with our fellow man.
entries.source_text: The Unity is our search for a higher level of life, and unity with our fellow man.

entries.text: “同一”是我们寻求更高级别的生活，团结我们同道的人。
entries.source_text: “同一”是我们寻求更高级别的生活，团结我们同道的人。

entries.text: He is another High Priest.  He spends much of his time in the studies.
entries.source_text: He is another High Priest.  He spends much of his time in the studies.

entries.text: 他是另一个高级牧师。他在研究上花费大量的时间。
entries.source_text: 他是另一个高级牧师。他在研究上花费大量的时间。

entries.text: My heart bleeds for them.  Led down a false path.  They don't know their efforts will bring only pain and suffering to their fellow beings.
entries.source_text: My heart bleeds for them.  Led down a false path.  They don't know their efforts will bring only pain and suffering to their fellow beings.

entries.text: 我替他们感到痛心。他们走在一条错误的道路上，不知道自己的努力只会给他们的教众带来痛苦和苦难。
entries.source_text: 我替他们感到痛心。他们走在一条错误的道路上，不知道自己的努力只会给他们的教众带来痛苦和苦难。

entries.text: Nicole is the unfortunate, confused leader of the Followers of the Apocalypse.
entries.source_text: Nicole is the unfortunate, confused leader of the Followers of the Apocalypse.
